@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CraftingRecipe:
    id: str
    display_name: str
    family: str
    station: str
    level: int
    base_exp: float
    requirements: Tuple[Tuple[str, int], ...]
    output_item: str
    output_qty: int = 1
    source: str = CRAFTING_SOURCE_ROOT
    source_enum: str = ""
    tradeable: bool = True
    category: str = "crafted"
    notes: str = ""
    source_item_id: Optional[int] = None
    # Extra items returned alongside the output (e.g. the emptied bucket from
    # molten glass smelting). Granted per action like the output, never gated.
    byproducts: Tuple[Tuple[str, int], ...] = ()

CRAFTING_RECIPES: Tuple[CraftingRecipe, ...] = (
    CraftingRecipe("chisel_limestone_brick", "Limestone brick", "stone", "chisel", 12, 6.0, _req(("Limestone", 1)), "Limestone brick", source=LIMESTONE_BRICK_SOURCE, source_item_id=3420),
    # Gem cutting. Semiprecious source crush chances are documented but not modeled;
    # one successful review is one completed Crafting action.
    CraftingRecipe("cut_opal", "Opal", "gems", "chisel", 1, 15.0, _req(("Uncut opal", 1)), "Opal", source=GEM_SOURCE, source_enum="OPAL", notes="Source has crush chance; AnkiScape treats the review action as a successful cut."),
    CraftingRecipe("cut_jade", "Jade", "gems", "chisel", 13, 20.0, _req(("Uncut jade", 1)), "Jade", source=GEM_SOURCE, source_enum="JADE", tradeable=False, notes="Source has crush chance; AnkiScape treats the review action as a successful cut."),
    CraftingRecipe("cut_red_topaz", "Red topaz", "gems", "chisel", 16, 25.0, _req(("Uncut red topaz", 1)), "Red topaz", source=GEM_SOURCE, source_enum="TOPAZ", tradeable=False, notes="Source has crush chance; AnkiScape treats the review action as a successful cut."),
    CraftingRecipe("cut_sapphire", "Sapphire", "gems", "chisel", 20, 50.0, _req(("Uncut sapphire", 1)), "Sapphire", source=GEM_SOURCE, source_enum="SAPPHIRE"),
    CraftingRecipe("cut_emerald", "Emerald", "gems", "chisel", 27, 67.0, _req(("Uncut emerald", 1)), "Emerald", source=GEM_SOURCE, source_enum="EMERALD"),

def crafting_recipes_as_dict() -> Dict[str, Dict[str, object]]:
    return {
        recipe.id: {
            "display_name": recipe.display_name,
            "family": recipe.family,
            "station": recipe.station,
            "level": recipe.level,
            "exp": recipe.base_exp,
            "requirements": dict(recipe.requirements),
            "output_item": recipe.output_item,
            "output_qty": recipe.output_qty,
            "source": recipe.source,
            "source_enum": recipe.source_enum,
            "tradeable": recipe.tradeable,
            "category": recipe.category,
            "notes": recipe.notes,
            "source_item_id": recipe.source_item_id,
            "byproducts": dict(recipe.byproducts),
            "required_items": dict(recipe.required_items),
            "consume_thread_on_roll": recipe.consume_thread_on_roll,

def _definition(
    name: str,
    category: ItemCategory,
    source: str,
    data: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, object]],
    images: Mapping[str, str],
) -> ItemDefinition:
    spec = data.get(name, {})
    return ItemDefinition(
        id=slugify_item_id(category, name),
        display_name=name,
        storage_key=name,
        category=category,
        asset_path=images.get(name),
        source=source,
        license_note="private-fork asset; provenance not audited",
        source_item_id=_source_item_id(spec),
        stackable=_bool_value(spec, "stackable", True),
        required_level=_level_value(spec),
        base_exp=_number_value(spec, "exp", 0.0),
        tradeable=_bool_value(spec, "tradeable", True),
        equipment_slot=str(spec["equipment_slot"]) if isinstance(spec.get("equipment_slot"), str) else None,
        equipment_type=str(spec["equipment_type"]) if isinstance(spec.get("equipment_type"), str) else None,
        equipment_tier=_level_value({"level": spec.get("tier", 0)}),

return "general"


def build_ge_item_catalog_pure(
    item_definitions: Iterable[ItemDefinition],
    *,
    item_values: Mapping[str, int],
    exchangeable_names: frozenset[str] | set[str],
    period_guide_prices: Mapping[str, int] | None = None,
    period_buy_limits: Mapping[str, int] | None = None,
    period_price_provenance: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, object]] | None = None,
    period_buy_limit_source: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, dict[str, object]]:
    period_guide_prices = period_guide_prices or {}
    period_buy_limits = period_buy_limits or {}
    period_price_provenance = period_price_provenance or {}
    period_buy_limit_source = period_buy_limit_source or {}
    catalog: dict[str, dict[str, object]] = {}
    for item in item_definitions:
        item_name = item.storage_key
        if (
            item_name == "Coins"
            or not item.tradeable
            or item_name not in exchangeable_names
        ):
            continue
        period_price = int(period_guide_prices.get(item_name, 0) or 0)
        cache_value = int(item_values.get(item_name, 0) or 0)
        guide_price = period_price if period_price > 0 else cache_value
        if guide_price <= 0:
            continue
        buy_limit = int(period_buy_limits.get(item_name, 0) or 0)
        catalog[item_name] = {
            "item_name": item_name,
            "item_id": item.id,
            "source_item_id": item.source_item_id,
            "category": item.category,
            "required_level": item.required_level,
            "source_role": _market_source_role(item.category),
            "asset_path": item.asset_path,
            "tradeable": True,
            "exchangeable": True,
            "guide_price": guide_price,
            "guide_price_source": (
                "period_grand_exchange_database"
                if period_price > 0
                else "cache_value_fallback"
            ),
            "guide_price_provenance": dict(
                period_price_provenance.get(item_name, {})
            ),
            "cache_value": cache_value if cache_value > 0 else None,
            "low_alchemy_value": int(cache_value * 0.4) if cache_value > 0 else None,
            "high_alchemy_value": int(cache_value * 0.6) if cache_value > 0 else None,
            "buy_limit": buy_limit if buy_limit > 0 else None,
            "buy_limit_source": (
                dict(period_buy_limit_source) if buy_limit > 0 else None
            ),

def write_generated(output_path: Path, harvested: Mapping[str, object]) -> None:
    prices = harvested["prices"]
    buy_limits = harvested["buy_limits"]
    provenance = harvested["provenance"]
    lines = [
        '"""Auto-generated pre-EOC Grand Exchange data. Do not edit.',
        "",
        "Sources are cutoff RuneScape Wiki Exchange revisions and the complete",
        "period buy-limit table. Regenerate with tools/generate_ge_period_data.py.",
        '"""',
        "",
        f"PERIOD_GE_BUY_LIMIT_SOURCE = {_python_literal(harvested['buy_limit_source'])}",
        "",
        "PERIOD_GE_GUIDE_PRICES = {",
    ]
    lines.extend(f"    {name!r}: {prices[name]}," for name in sorted(prices))
    lines.extend(["}", "", "PERIOD_GE_BUY_LIMITS = {"])
    lines.extend(f"    {name!r}: {buy_limits[name]}," for name in sorted(buy_limits))
    lines.extend(["}", "", "PERIOD_GE_PRICE_PROVENANCE = {"])
    for name in sorted(provenance):
        lines.append(f"    {name!r}: {_python_literal(provenance[name])},")
    lines.extend(["}", ""])
    output_path.write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

if [[ $# -lt 2 ]]; then
  echo "usage: $0 <disk.zip|cache-dir> <item-name-term|--id> [term|id ...]" >&2
  exit 2
fi

source_path=$1
shift
script_dir=$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
java_bin=${JAVA_BIN:-/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@25/bin/java}
gradle_cache=${GRADLE_CACHE:-$HOME/.gradle/caches/modules-2/files-2.1}

if [[ ! -x "$java_bin" ]]; then
  echo "Java 25 launcher not found at $java_bin; set JAVA_BIN." >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [[ ! -d "$gradle_cache/rs.darkan/core/2.0.5" ]]; then
  echo "Darkan core 2.0.5 is not present under $gradle_cache." >&2
  exit 1
fi

temp_dir=
cleanup() {
  if [[ -n "$temp_dir" ]]; then
    rm -rf "$temp_dir"
  fi
}
trap cleanup EXIT

if [[ "$source_path" == *.zip ]]; then
  temp_dir=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ankiscape-openrs2.XXXXXX")
  unzip -q "$source_path" -d "$temp_dir"
  cache_dir="$temp_dir/cache"
else
  cache_dir=$source_path
fi

if [[ ! -f "$cache_dir/main_file_cache.dat2" ]]; then
  echo "No RuneScape disk cache found at $cache_dir." >&2
  exit 1
fi

classpath=$(find "$gradle_cache" -name '*.jar' -print | paste -sd: -)
exec "$java_bin" --class-path "$classpath" \
  "$script_dir/OpenRs2CacheItemSearch.java" "$cache_dir" "$@"

def _known_non_shop_item_names():
    names = set()
    for mapping in (
        QUEST_REWARD_ITEM_DATA,
        WOODCUTTING_EXTRA_ITEM_DATA,
        MINING_EXTRA_ITEM_DATA,
        SMITHING_EXTRA_ITEM_DATA,
        FIREMAKING_EXTRA_ITEM_DATA,
        FISHING_EXTRA_ITEM_DATA,
        HUNTER_EXTRA_ITEM_DATA,
        COOKING_EXTRA_ITEM_DATA,
        CRAFTING_REQUIRED_ITEM_DATA,
        CRAFTING_SPECIAL_ITEM_DATA,
        RUNECRAFTING_EXTRA_ITEM_DATA,
        HERBLORE_EXTRA_ITEM_DATA,
        COMBAT_EXTRA_ITEM_DATA,
        CONSTRUCTION_EXTRA_ITEM_DATA,
        FARMING_ITEM_DATA,
        THIEVING_EXTRA_ITEM_DATA,
        FISH_FLINGERS_EXTRA_ITEM_DATA,
        GREAT_ORB_PROJECT_EXTRA_ITEM_DATA,
        DUEL_ARENA_EXTRA_ITEM_DATA,
        CRUCIBLE_EXTRA_ITEM_DATA,
        GOBLIN_RAIDS_EXTRA_ITEM_DATA,
        SHADES_OF_MORTTON_EXTRA_ITEM_DATA,
    ):
        names.update(mapping)
    names.update(MINING_OUTPUT_ITEMS)
    names.update(WOODCUTTING_LOG_ITEMS)
    names.update(FIREMAKING_LOG_ITEMS)
    names.update(FIREMAKING_OUTPUT_ITEMS)
    names.update(BAR_DATA)
    names.update(GEM_DATA)
    names.update(FISHING_OUTPUT_ITEMS)
    names.update(COOKING_OUTPUT_ITEMS)
    names.update(RUNECRAFTING_OUTPUT_ITEMS)
    names.update(RUNECRAFTING_ACCESS_ITEMS)
    names.update(HERBLORE_OUTPUT_ITEMS)
    names.update(HUNTER_OUTPUT_ITEMS)
    for spec in CRAFTING_DATA.values():
        if isinstance(spec.get("output_item"), str):
            names.add(spec["output_item"])
        names.update(spec.get("requirements", {}))
    for spec in FLETCHING_DATA.values():
        if isinstance(spec.get("output_item"), str):
            names.add(spec["output_item"])
        names.update(spec.get("requirements", {}))
    for spec in HUNTER_DATA.values():
        names.update(spec.get("requirements", {}))
    for spec in UTILITY_ACTIVITY_DATA.values():
        if isinstance(spec.get("output_item"), str):
            names.add(spec["output_item"])
        outputs = spec.get("outputs", {})
        if isinstance(outputs, dict):
            names.update(outputs)
        names.update(spec.get("requirements", {}))
    return names - ({spec.get("output_item") for spec in UTILITY_ACTIVITY_DATA.values() if spec.get("group") == "material_processing"} & SHOP_EXTRA_ITEM_DATA.keys())
